lean_verification.scope: Exact APSP correctness and O(n^2.99294792) charged work for the complete constructed program in its binary-arithmetic and bounded indexed-array/control model. The closed final theorem includes the constructed embedding, LOW/HIGH caches, binary cyclic arithmetic, deterministic certification, parameter setup, and adaptive APSP reductions. Original hypotheses: polynomially bounded integer weights and no negative cycles. It is not a whole-program word-RAM compilation or Lean evaluator performance theorem. Other result rows and historical witnesses remain outside this formalization.
lean_verification.extension_status: In progress: the level-one equal-copy rank conversion is now closed. CWRectangularRanks.exists_fixed_base supplies one positive integral CW base and exact rational rectangular matrix-power decompositions of aspect (861/500,1,15), with at most t*Q^(16.7220001*k) terms. Actual extracted coordinates, strict analytic entropy margins, interpolation/extraction losses, incomplete batches and cyclic orientation are proved. Coefficient magnitudes are bounded by (r*H)^k and a constructed common denominator by d^k, with fixed H,d derived from the base data. This is a rank construction, not yet a retained fast binary execution theorem. The recursive evaluator, its complete bit/control/padding costs, efficient graph batching, rounded phases and adaptive APSP cost integration remain unfinished. The requested 2.9926862626 theorem is unproved; the closed APSP theorem remains 2.99294792 and imports none of the 208 extension modules.
lean_verification.extension_runtime_limitations: Frozen full verification checked 343 modules and 3726 axiom reports using only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound. The independent Python and actual Lean equal-copy fixtures each checked 168 padded-routing cases, four recursion depths, 2232 coefficient bounds/common denominators and 24 simultaneous dot-product outputs with signed rational coefficients. The existing Lean entropy fixture and full Python suite were rerun successfully. Positive-scale target CW words were handled symbolically, not materialized. The new rank theorem does not price dense-form evaluation, binary execution or APSP work. The earlier closed APSP sources and historical snapshots remain unchanged.
